newsitem.title: USA: Vermont Teddy Bear sees Q3, FY loss.
newsitem.headline: Vermont Teddy Bear sees Q3, FY loss.

text.p: The Vermont Teddy Bear Co said on Thursday that it expects to post losses for third quarter ended March 31, 1997 and the fiscal year.

The company intends to officially release its third quarter earnings in early May, but currently estimates that it will post a net loss to common stockholders of between $0.10 and $0.15 per share for third quarter on revenues of approximately $5.3 million, it said.
In the comparable quarter of the prior year, the company earned six cents per share on revenues of $5.1 million.

Vermont Teddy Bear said the third quarter traditionally has been the most profitable quarter for the company, and as a result of the projected loss, the company anticipates that it will also post a loss fiscal year.
At this time, the company does not have a firm estimate as to the size of the expected loss, given that there are three months remaining in the current fiscal year, the company said.

In an unrelated development, on April 10, 1997, the company received an extension on its $1 million credit line through September 26, 1997, and has received a letter of commitment regarding an extension of the company's mortgage on its Shelburne headquarters through September 26, 1998.
Vermont Teddy Bear said the extensions will assure the company that it has adequate working capital for the next 12 months.
